governing.name: sharingu Brand Guidelines v2
governing.note: v1 was written to stop AI slop and it worked, but it also stopped the page from having any presence. Nine rules loosened on purpose, each with a reason.

worlds.name: Paper
worlds.what: where people read: the marketing page and documents. Never pure white as the page; white is a card that sits on paper.

worlds.name: Ink
worlds.what: the PRODUCT's own look: near-black, orange accents, mono data. Product panels, terminal frames, one band per page.

tokens.u: orange tint: avatars, the selected node, "viewing"

colourRules: Orange carries INK text, never white, and never body-size text on paper: use orange-deep for that.
Green appears only for verified and binding.
Red exists only for errors, and always with an icon.
Presence colours live on avatars, cursors and pins only.
Tool and AI logos keep their own colours. We do not recolour Slack.
On Ink, the three states are the Ink states set (verified-ink, needs-ink, error-ink) plus stone; Paper's values stay on Paper.
Orange is identity, never a state: every state chip takes a state colour (stateChips).

depth.u: the artifact: product boards, the hero object
depth.v: anything that should feel picked up off the page

depth.u: the pinned note: question cards, decisions, the U-chan note
the pinned note on Ink: one per screen, on a dark-2 card
depth.v: 5px 5px 0 #FB923C. The Paper pin is a hard INK offset, and ink is invisible on #0F0E0D; orange is the one brand colour that reads there as a hard edge.

voice.line: Inform, justify, never hype. Playful, warm, real. Short declaratives. Every claim carries its reason.
hard: No em dashes anywhere. Use a full stop, a colon or a comma.
Specific beats clever: names, times, ids and numbers when they are real, or clearly a made-up example.
No numbers from the real production org in public.
keepers: Authority is a human act. Always.
Nobody updates the dashboard. The dashboard is what updating looks like.

loosened.v1: Light only. Dark only inside terminal frames.
loosened.v2: Two worlds. Paper for the marketing page, Ink for the machine. Both are the brand.

loosened.v1: Four surface levels and 1px lines, never shadow.
loosened.v2: Add three named shadows, tilt, overlap and bleed. Flat boxes on a flat plane are now the failure.

loosened.v1: Flat paper, flat peach. No gradients or imagery.
loosened.v2: Paper-to-peach washes, a dark band, faint grain, the mascot and product artifacts as backdrops. Still no blue-purple, no mesh, no glow blobs.
The identity, used with conviction: hero mark, one full band per page, agent tiles, primary button. Always with ink text.
A heartbeat: at least four authored motions per page. Never hide content behind a reveal.
Drawn in the U-chan line: thick ink outline, rounded. No icon packs.

loosened.v1: Lowkey, sparingly, never louder than the work.
loosened.v2: At scale where it earns it: hero, footer, empty states, the U-chan note.

superseded.was: the V1 SPA law: warm paper, one orange

inkStates.what: The door's three states on a near-black ground: the same hues as Paper's, lightened to read on #1A1917 (Paper amber sat near 3:1). Each has a well, the tint its chip sits on.

tokens.u: errors only, always with an icon
incomplete: glyphs, dashed lines and large text on Ink; small incomplete text is dark-text-2 on the dark-3 well

stateChips.what: Every state and severity chip maps to ONE brand colour. Red is errors only. Orange is identity, never a state.

chips.why: a blocker waits on a person's ruling: needs-a-person at full strength. It was red; red is errors only.
a question a person owes, below a blocker
an open filing waits on a person
a human act is owed: amber means a human has to rule. It was red.
a human act is owed. It was orange; orange is identity, not a state.
recorded and attributed, binding on no one yet
binding: green appears only for verified and binding
incomplete: something is missing. It was red.
ruled, not built: incomplete, not a person's act. It was amber.

chips.token: error-ink on its well, with an icon
chips.why: the ERROR and UNREACHABLE state patterns only

stateChips.helper: ONE helper, stateChip(state, word?) in engine/src/ui.js, renders every chip as data-chip=<one of the 11>; its colours live once (UI-B5a).

behind.what: BEHIND: the page a person reads is older than the served set. ONE pattern, the same everywhere, beside EMPTY, LOADING, ERROR and UNREACHABLE.
behind.icon: its own (a clock with a return arrow), never the ERROR or UNREACHABLE icon
never: orange: orange is identity, never a state
behind.says: what moved and that acting still works (Q47C9CCD3: it warns and still lets you act); its one action is "See v<n>"
behind.why: Behind is not an error and not a person's act: incomplete-family stone reads as "not the latest" without alarm. The Versions artboard drew it in orange; that line is superseded (wireframe wf-versions superseded[]).

tempo.what: Runs are not in the product (r113). What Build and Home show instead is where each FILING is: its tempo.

stages.u: filed and graded at the door
approved or ruled; a reject or needs-work shows REVIEW with its verdict word, never green (QB74B1B7E)
landed and drawn on the Map
sent back for one more thing

type.u: page titles, tracking -2% on the product (the brand's -5% is for the marketing display size)
the wordmark and mark, agent names, big numbers

tokenDecisions.why: QB90F6CC4 ruled them brand tokens, not the board's own; this is the named Ink states set that ruling asked the brand to carry.

tokenDecisions.decision: JOIN as each Ink state's well
tokenDecisions.why: Brand v2 chips are "tinted"; a tint on Ink needs a value, and one per hue keeps a chip's ground and text the same state.
Paper has ink and ink-2; Ink had one text token. The artboards use it 500 times for secondary text, and stone on dark-2 falls below the body-text floor.
Ink draws its hairline in dark-3 (#262421), which vanishes on a dark-3 well. Controls and wells need one step up; stone would read as "incomplete".
Ink's counterpart to peach: the orange tint for avatars, the selected node and "viewing". Identity, never a state.

tokenDecisions.token: the canvas lane palette (blue, violet, green, red, a paper amber: 17 values)
tokenDecisions.decision: CHANGE the artboards to existing tokens
tokenDecisions.why: Brand v2 bans lane hues. A node kind is told by its ground and line (dark-3 / dark-2 / dark, dark-text-2 / stone), missing things by a dashed stone line, the selected node by orange.

tokenDecisions.decision: CHANGE to Manrope 800/700, Fredoka 600 and JetBrains Mono
tokenDecisions.why: Brand v2 type: three voices, no serif.
